Card Q&A.a: No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.  In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.  A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
Card Q&A.q: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't.  Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.
Card Q&A.q: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?

Card Q&A.a: 3 cards. In this case, there are 3 colors (red, blue, and yellow) in your opponent's Digimon and Tamers, therefore you trash 3 cards from the tops of both players' decks.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 1 red and blue Digimon and 1 red and yellow Tamer. How many cards do I trash from the tops of both players' decks when this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it is.If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] For each color your opponent's Digimon and Tamers have, trash 1 card from the tops of both players' decks. Then, for each card this effect trashed, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
[End of Attack] By deleting 1 level 4 or lower purple Digimon, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level.
Inherited Effect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
